title.purpose: Card headings, modal titles, in-page sub-sections.

body.purpose: All prose content. Max 65–75ch line length.

label.purpose: Metadata stamps, status pills, AI-generated markers only.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default for color/border state changes (hover, focus).

motion.name: scale
motion.purpose: Emoji/icon scale on mood tile hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single primary CTA per view. White on void.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 24px; background: #ffffff; color: #030712; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e5e7eb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #374151; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Navigation CTAs, browse actions. Shelf surface with Jacket border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 24px; background: #1f2937; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #4b5563; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #374151; border-color: #6b7280; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #374151; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Search, vibe prompt, and form fields. Cabinet bg, Jacket border.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. dark moody post-punk…" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; background: #111827; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #4b5563; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #9ca3af; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #9ca3af; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky top nav. Cabinet bg, Jacket border-bottom.
components.html:
Black Circles
Collection
components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: #111827; border-bottom: 1px solid #4b5563; } .ds-nav > div, .ds-nav__brand, .ds-nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 24px; height: 64px; } .ds-nav__brand { gap: 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__wordmark { color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav__links { gap: 24px; } .ds-nav__link { color: #9ca3af; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav__link--active { color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Mood Tile
components.description: Emoji-led square card for mood selection. Key interactive element on the home screen.
components.css: .ds-mood-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: #111827; border: 2px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-mood-tile:hover { border-color: #374151; background: rgba(31,41,55,0.8); } .ds-mood-tile__emoji { font-size: 2.5rem; margin-bottom: 12px; display: block; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-mood-tile:hover .ds-mood-tile__emoji { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-mood-tile__label { color: #ffffff; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Insight Panel
components.description: AI-generated personality blurb. Cabinet surface, discreet header treatment.
components.html:
Music personalityAI generated

Your collection skews heavily toward late-night introspection — equal parts post-punk austerity and jazz-club warmth.
components.css: .ds-insight { background: #111827; border: 1px solid #1f2937; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; } .ds-insight__header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-insight__title { font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-insight__badge { font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-insight__body { color: #e5e7eb; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-line; margin: 0; }

components.name: Flash / Alert
components.description: Success and error flash messages. Brief, dismissible, at top of content area.
components.css: .ds-flash { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Figtree, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-flash--success { background: #14532d; border: 1px solid #15803d; color: #86efac; } .ds-flash--error { background: #450a0a; border: 1px solid #991b1b; color: #fca5a5; }

narrative.overview:
Black Circles is a collector's display case — dark, purposeful, and slightly austere. Every surface is calibrated to recede so that album art and metadata can speak. The UI provides the frame; the records are the light source. Nothing decorates for its own sake.

The depth system is purely tonal: void (#030712) as the body, cabinet (#111827) for surfaces, shelf (#1f2937) for raised interactive elements. No shadows. No blur. The hierarchy reads through darkness, not through chrome. A single oxblood accent (#7c1f25) breaks the neutrals only where interaction demands it.

This system explicitly rejects streaming-platform energy and SaaS dashboard aesthetics. The AI inside the app is a quiet concierge. It should not be visible in the design at all.
keyCharacteristics: One restrained accent color (oxblood), used sparingly
Density as an aesthetic choice, not a problem to solve
Album art is always the most prominent element on any given screen
Type is functional — one weight family, hierarchy through size and color only

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Oxblood appears on ≤5% of any screen. One active nav link, one focus ring, one key label at most.

rules.name: The Contrast Mandate
rules.body: Body and supporting prose must use Label (#9ca3af) or brighter. Dust (#6b7280) is permitted only for non-content metadata — never running text.

rules.name: The No-Pairing Rule
rules.body: Figtree only, at all times. Introducing a second family breaks the catalogue density the system is calibrated for.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling
rules.body: Uppercase + wide tracking appears only on Label-tier elements (metadata stamps, status markers). Never on buttons, body text, or headings above 12px.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is prohibited on all product surfaces. Elevation is expressed by background-color step, never by shadow.

dos: Do let album art be the most visually prominent element on any screen. Crop it square; give it space.
Do use tonal elevation (Cabinet → Shelf → Groove) to create depth. Never use box-shadow.
Do treat the Oxblood accent as a signal, not a style. One active state per view at most.
Do use Label (#9ca3af) as the minimum text color for any prose or supporting copy.
Do keep the AI invisible. No robot icons, no 'Powered by AI' labels.
Do embrace density. Let the catalogue be dense — that's what collectors love about Discogs.
donts: Don't use Spotify-style visual language: rounded pill cards, green-tinted dark mode, algorithm-surfaced sections.
Don't apply a SaaS dashboard aesthetic: no sidebar navigation, no blue primary buttons, no metric cards, no border-left accent stripes on callouts.
Don't put AI front and center in any UI copy or iconography. The intelligence is a concierge. It does not have a face.
Don't use box-shadow on any product surface.
Don't use uppercase tracking on elements above Label tier (12px metadata stamps only).
Don't let the oxblood accent appear on backgrounds, large text, or more than one element per view.
Don't use Dust (#6b7280) for body text or any text the user needs to read. It fails 4.5:1 contrast against Void.
Don't introduce a second typeface. Figtree only.
